requirement.description: Multiple test failures related to incorrect handling of StructLayout and UnionLayout objects when used as integer values, causing TypeError when trying to interpret them as integers.
requirement.contract: Layout classes (StructLayout, UnionLayout, ArrayLayout, FlexibleLayout) must properly implement the __int__ method or prevent conversion to integer context. When these layouts are passed to contexts expecting integers (like in constant construction or indexing), they should either properly convert or raise appropriate TypeError with descriptive message.

requirement.description: Missing class definitions for SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes that are referenced in tests but not implemented.
requirement.contract: The SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes must be properly defined in amaranth.lib.io module with all required methods and attributes to support the test cases.

requirement.description: Incorrect error messages for IO port validation in Instance and IOBuffer instances, expecting specific error message formats that don't match actual implementation.
requirement.contract: IO port validation error messages in Instance and IOBuffer classes must match expected format from test cases exactly. Specifically, error messages should match patterns like "^'port' length \\(4\\) doesn't match 'o' length \\(1\\)$" rather than using generic "pad" terminology.

requirement.description: Missing from_bits method implementation for Struct and Union classes that should be inherited from ShapeCastable.
requirement.contract: Struct and Union classes must implement from_bits method or properly inherit from ShapeCastable to support the from_bits functionality tested in tests.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of IO ports in netlist building that prevents proper transformation of IO ports to netlist representations.
requirement.contract: IO ports (IOPort, IOBufferInstance) must be properly handled in netlist building process to avoid TypeError when transforming IO values to netlist representation.
